qsm-tasks ready.description: List the open Todo tasks and bugs, unblocked and not deferred, by Priority then number

qsm-tasks list.description: List the issues on the board, filtered by feature, kind, Status, priority, label or change

qsm-tasks show.description: Print one issue: its facts, blockers, sub-issue counts, body and comments

qsm-tasks feature.description: File a Feature at Todo from an intent file

qsm-tasks add.description: Add a Task as a sub-issue of an open feature

qsm-tasks feedback.description: File feedback on the marketplace as a plain issue from its template, with its labels

qsm-tasks edit.description: Change an issue's title, priority, body, assignee, feature, order or change

qsm-tasks note.description: Post one comment on an issue, the text unchanged

qsm-tasks claim.description: Take a Todo task or bug: In Dev, assigned to the caller, on the board

qsm-tasks unclaim.description: Give a task back: Todo and unassigned, or deferred until a given value

qsm-tasks review.description: Move a task or bug to Agent Review

qsm-tasks human.description: Hand an approved task with green checks to the owner: Ready For Human, then Human Review

qsm-tasks close.description: Close an issue with its reason as a comment, as completed or not planned

qsm-tasks reopen.description: Reopen a closed task, bug or feedback under an open parent, at Todo

qsm-tasks plan.description: Return a feature to Todo for planning

qsm-tasks qa.description: Start the test of a feature at Ready For Test with no open sub-issue: In Test

qsm-tasks doctor.description: Check gh, the repository, the board, its fields, labels, workflows and views

qsm-tasks flow.description: Print the Status and Priority tables: each Status per kind and each verb's guard

qsm-tasks setup.description: Create the board's missing fields, options and labels; never rename or delete
